Which upstream failures become which tagged errors?
decisions.answer: ConnectionClosedError <- instanceof ConnectionClosedError; ProtocolError <- instanceof ProtocolError; TimeoutError <- instanceof TimeoutError; TouchError <- instanceof TouchError; UnsupportedOperation <- instanceof UnsupportedOperation; PuppeteerError
decisions.why: exported error classes, most specific first, then the catch-all PuppeteerError carrying `code` (the source sets ESCAPED_CHAR, EACCES, EPERM)

decisions.why: every offered export that acquires a releasable handle

decisions.question: Why a second revision of this upstream version?
decisions.why: the engine now wraps handles held in properties (puppeteer page.keyboard and page.mouse were raw upstream objects whose methods returned promises)
